summary: The MIT-licensed No AI Slop repository recommends preserving client voice and facts, making the minimum effective edit, avoiding fabricated claims, naming observable patterns instead of claiming AI detection, and testing whether copy could move unchanged to another company. Design DNA adapts those methods but rejects punctuation, word, and sentence-form policing as a universal authorship or quality test.
